title: LGS1920 Studio launch registration
description: Register to receive launch updates and learn how to stay connected afterwards.
registrationIntro: Register to receive launch updates and learn how to stay connected afterwards.

hero.title: Live outdoor adventures, share the stories.
hero.lead: Walk, run or ride, then import, edit, replay and export videos of your journeys for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or other social networks without leaving your browser.

panel.title: Something amazing is on the way.
panel.lead: Stay tuned and register for launch updates to be among the first to discover what Studio has in store.

items.title: Import your trail, ride or trek and review it.
Explore a global, 3D playground!
items.text: Worldwide layers and dynamic widgets (profiles, live data, compass, text, and more to come).

items.title: Export and share
items.text: Share videos of your adventures on social networks and export HTML or PDF reports.

items.title: Privacy first
items.text: Your data stays with you: browser, device, or cloud.
items.note: Cloud access will be available in a future version.

items.title: Studio is free
items.text: Studio is completely free and will remain so.
items.note: Some external services accessible through Studio may be paid services from their providers. Studio has no affiliation with any of the providers concerned.

privacy: Your details are used only to contact you about the Studio launch. They are not sold or shared for advertising. You can withdraw your consent or request access, correction, or deletion at any time by writing to studio@lgs1920.fr. We keep your registration data only for the launch information period, then review it.
